g_notes: SKIP — performance appraisal is post-hire performance management, explicitly outside our world (skills assessment/pre-hire testing), not a subject we can own.
SKIP — job evaluation is a compensation and pay-equity process (wage grids, salary structures), a different product world from skills assessment/hiring.

angle_gap: The guide spends nearly all its length on definitions and the 7 types of recruitment, then reduces the selection step — the part that actually determines who gets hired — to one throwaway line: 'various assessments like skills evaluations and personality assessments.' It never explains which assessments to use, how to validate them, or how they replace resume screening, leaving the most decision-critical part of the funnel unaddressed.
asset: Recruitment Fundamentals for Teams Ready to Screen on Skills, Not Resumes
distinct_angle: Expands the guide's one-line 'skills evaluations' mention into a full treatment of how to design and validate skills-based selection inside the recruitment funnel — the exact step this page glosses over.

g_notes: SKIP — HR career path content is aimed at HR professionals planning their own career growth, not at recruiters trying to hire; belongs to AIHR's certification-course world, not ours.
SKIP — cultural transformation is organizational culture and change-leadership content, a different product world from pre-employment skills assessment.
